question: Which superstar got married and told the world with one photo?
story: Cristiano Ronaldo just got married in secret, and the entire planet found out from a photo of two hands. According to TMZ, the Washington Post, and Al Jazeera, the soccer superstar and Georgina Rodriguez tied the knot on August eleventh in a civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal. No stadium. No hundred person guest list leaking for weeks in advance. A press release reportedly described it as a private and intimate moment. Here is how he announced it. Ronaldo posted one photo to Instagram. Their two hands, side by side, wedding bands dead center in the frame, captioned with a C, a heart, and a G. That is the entire announcement, from the most followed person on Instagram. The timing is the part fans caught. They reportedly married exactly one year to the day after Georgina announced their engagement. Ten years together, one ring photo, zero words.
